_note: Text of the 8 co-op scenario sheets (Uneasy Alliances v2.2.01), used to draw them in the Ambition-sheet style. Row 'slots' is either a number of progress circles or "AB" (one per player). Circle order (row by row, left to right, fame row last) matches the progress circles detected on the PDF, so saved games keep their marks.

A.intro: Jabba the Hutt is looking to expand the influence of his cartel into new markets, making a name for himself across the galaxy. He is looking for a worthy crew that can help him destroy some competition and share in his profits. This would guarantee a place in Jabba’s organization and set you up for life!

rows.title: Prove your loyalty to the Hutts
Make a name for yourselves as smugglers
rows.text: Deliver a combined total of 4 illegal cargo.

rows.title: Gain Jabba’s attention
Scope out the competition

B.intro: Jabba says to make your move! You will need to work together to strike a blow against the competition, procure some desirable cargo and set up a network in the Black Market.

final.title: Carve out a place for Jabba on the Ring of Kafrene

A.intro: Valarian, the Whiphid leader of a growing cartel on Tatooine, has a score to settle with Jabba the Hutt. To put an end to the constant struggle for dominance of the planet, Valarian has set her sights on disrupting his operations by convincing many of those loyal to Jabba to see things her way.

rows.title: Assemble a crew large enough for the job
rows.text: Have a combined total of 4 crew members.

rows.title: Remove some competition
rows.text: Collect a reward from five bounties.

rows.title: Stir up dissension among the Hutt council
Enlist the support of Jabba’s off-world rivals

B.intro: Valarian’s message says that it’s go time! You need to create supply train issues for Jabba’s enterprise, create a false summons for Jabba to appear before the Hutt Council and then go for the heart of his empire by hitting Jabba’s Palace itself. Once Jabba’s Palace is yours, no one can stand in your way!

jobs.title: Create supply train issues for Jabba’s Enterprise
Create supply train issues for Jabba’s Enterprise

final.title: Lure Jabba off Tatooine with a false summons from the Hutt council
Hit Jabba’s Palace while he is away

A.intro: Governor Wilhuff Tarkin has been tasked with putting down the Rebel uprising on Ryloth. Twi’lek freedom fighters are being supported and supplied from a mysterious benefactor. The crew that gets rid of them could retire comfortably on the reward.

rows.title: Prove your loyalty to the Empire
Plant an informant on Ryloth
rows.text: Eliminate a crew (remove from game) that has two skills on Ryloth.

rows.title: Demonstrate your usefulness to the Empire
Work as a double agent on Mon Calamari to gain the trust of the Rebels

B.intro: Tarkin contacts your crew with a lead about the source of the Rebel support. You’ll need to follow up on the lead and then follow the trail as far as it goes to eliminate the Rebel cell supporting the uprising on Ryloth.

jobs.title: Follow up on a lead about the source of Rebel support
Follow up on a lead about the source of Rebel support

final.title: Destroy the cell supplying the Rebels

A.intro: Agent Ulrich Trask of the ISB has received reports of a Rebel incursion on Lothal. He is assembling a team to infiltrate Governor Tarkin’s ranks to root out the Rebel sympathizers without Tarkin knowing, intending to receive the glory for himself. The team that assists will be greatly rewarded.

rows.title: Assemble a crew large enough for the job
rows.text: Have a combined total of 4 crew members.

rows.title: Gain notoriety as a Bounty Hunter
rows.text: Collect a reward from a bounty for two contracts with Strength 5 or higher.

rows.title: Demonstrate your usefulness to the ISB
Establish a reputation with the criminal underworld
rows.text: Encounter the Ring of Kafrene space.

B.intro: Agent Trask is ready to move on Lothal. He needs your team to obtain Imperial communication records to identify the Rebel Cell. Once identified, you’ll need to create a distraction to lure Tarkin off of Lothal before uncovering and eliminating the cell.

jobs.title: Obtain Imperial communication records from an ISB Office
Obtain Imperial communication records from a reconnaissance ship

final.title: Create a distraction to lure Tarkin off world
Uncover the Rebel Cell before Tarkin returns

A.intro: Mon Mothma, the unofficial leader of the Rebellion, is working on outfitting a Corellian Corvette with a new technology that would be capable of causing damage to an important shipyard in the core. Mon Mothma is looking for a team that can help develop and deploy the ship.

rows.title: Prove your loyalty to the Rebellion
Deliver an engineer to the project site on Mon Calamari
rows.text: Eliminate one of your crew (remove from game) that has Knowledge and/or Tactics.

rows.title: Assist the Rebel cause at Ryloth
Scope out the black market on the Ring of Kafrene
rows.text: Encounter the Ring of Kafrene space.

B.intro: Mon Mothma makes contact to inform you that the ship needs a delivery of Chromium before it is complete, and then the ship will need an escort and someone to create a distraction at the Imperial shipyard.

final.title: Sabotage the Imperial Shipyard defense network

A.intro: Arane Oreida, the Zabrak leader of a partisan Rebel extremist group, wants the Rebel Alliance’s modified flagship, the Shining Hope, for herself, and plans to use it to do some real damage to the Empire.

rows.title: Outfit yourself properly
rows.text: Have a combined worth (both players’ ships, gear and mods) of at least 60,000 credits.

rows.title: Gain the attention of the Partisans
rows.text: Win a combined total of six combats.

rows.title: Make contact with a Partisan recruiter
Run reconnaissance of the project site on Mon Calamari

B.intro: Arane informs you that the Rebellion’s special project is complete and ready for the taking! You’ll need to create a distraction, steal the modified Corellian Corvette, and then escort it to Naboo where the Partisan crew can decimate the capital city of Theed.

jobs.title: Plant false intel to draw the Shining Hope out
Plant false intel to draw the Shining Hope out

final.title: Unleash the Shining Hope against Naboo

A.intro: Dryden Vos is looking for a team to further disrupt the war-torn planet of Ryloth to allow Crimson Dawn to assert control. He is looking for the right group of agitators for the job, and will reward success and ambition with a place of power and wealth in his organization.

rows.title: Recruit a large enough crew
rows.text: Have a combined total of 4 crew members.

rows.title: Establish yourselves as capable agitators
rows.text: Win a combined total of 6 combats.

rows.title: Create connections in the Syndicate
Make contact with the Hutts

B.intro: It is time to isolate Ryloth by cutting off Rebel support, then by redirecting Rebel reinforcements away from the planet. Then, seize the opportunity to establish Crimson Dawn as the new rulers of Ryloth.

jobs.title: Cut off Rebel support to Ryloth from Mon Calamari
Cut off Rebel support to Ryloth from the Rebel Fleet

final.title: Redirect Rebel reinforcements away from Ryloth
Assert the power of Crimson Dawn on Ryloth

A.intro: A mysterious woman called Q enlists your help in implicating Dryden Vos in collusion with the Hutt Council, an offense that won’t be overlooked by his superiors. She needs a crew that can be effective and discreet to work for her so she can keep her hands clean.

rows.title: Get an inside man on Dryden’s ship, the First Light
rows.text: Eliminate a crew (remove from game) that has either Stealth or Influence on Ord Mantell.

rows.title: Prove your resourcefulness
rows.text: Complete a combined total of 6 jobs.

rows.title: Gain the trust of the Syndicate
Gather intel on the Hutt Council

B.intro: Q lets you know that things are in place to turn Dryden Vos’ life upside down. All you need to do is make some Crimson Dawn shipments disappear, steal a valuable piece of cargo from the Hutts and plant evidence that Vos is working with the Hutts so he will take the fall.

jobs.title: Create a disruption in Crimson Dawn’s supply train
Create a disruption in Crimson Dawn’s supply train

final.title: Steal a stash of Beskar from the Hutts
Plant the evidence on the First Light
